Store a Small Design as Base Matrices

Source: R/spec.R
densify_small.Rd

Converts the sparse blocks of a design to base matrices when the equations together carry fewer than min_dim coefficients and the caller has not requested sparse storage for any block.

Usage

densify_small(design, min_dim = 100L)

Arguments

design

The design, a list with one entry per distribution parameter, and each entry holds its block as X.

min_dim

The number of coefficients below which the design is stored dense.

Value

The design, with every X a base matrix where the total is below min_dim, and unchanged otherwise.

Details

A random effect builds its block sparse whatever its size. Below about a hundred coefficients the sparse route costs more than it saves, because its fixed cost is the coercions and the S4 dispatch around each product, which do not shrink with the matrix; worth_sparse() records the same crossover for the factorization. The conversion is applied only where every block is independent of the coefficients and the design has no structural term, since other designs are rebuilt during the fit and a rebuilt block would come back sparse. A block that the caller requested sparse (sparse = TRUE on a term, linpar_options(sparse = TRUE), a sparse matrix as input) is never converted, and the rest of the design is not converted either: the design keeps the storage that it was given.
